C-AUTOMATE-TAP-SOUND.IntentSummary: Add one root interceptor that clicks on genuine taps and stays silent on drags, teach the route observer to sound popups, and delete the thirteen hand-written calls that automation makes redundant, keeping only the four that carry meaning.

MustPassCommand.Command: test -e lib/widgets/tap_sound_area.dart && grep -q 'kTouchSlop' lib/widgets/tap_sound_area.dart && grep -q 'TapSoundArea' lib/app.dart

test "$(grep -rho 'context.sfx(Sfx.tap)' lib/ | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 1 && test "$(grep -rl 'context.sfx(Sfx.tap)' lib/ | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 1 && grep -q 'context.sfx(Sfx.tap)' lib/widgets/tap_sound_area.dart

T-001.Title: Add the root tap interceptor and wrap the app in it

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: lib/widgets/tap_sound_area.dart watches pointer down, move and up, and plays the press effect only when the pointer lifted within kTouchSlop of where it landed.
Input passes straight through: the interceptor uses a translucent hit-test behaviour, so no gesture, scroll or drag changes.
Only the first pointer of a multi-touch gesture can fire, and a fresh press resets the tracking.
app.dart wraps the router with it, so dialogs and sheets are covered too — they render inside the wrapped app.

T-002.Title: Teach the route observer to sound popups

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A pushed popup route plays the open effect and a popped one plays close, while page routes keep navigate and back.
The first route is still silent, since opening the app is not something the user did.
The daily-race sheet stops playing its own open and close, so one sheet opening makes one sound rather than two.

T-003.Title: Delete the press calls automation replaces

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The nine context.sfx(Sfx.tap) calls are gone from the hub, both dealership cards, the error retry and the five daily-races buttons, along with any import or wrapper that existed only to play them.

The only press call left in the app is the interceptor's own; what remains beside it is the four calls carrying a meaning automation cannot infer — the tab switch, the back path and the two menu entries of the sound toggle.
The doc comment that used a press call as its example now describes the automatic layer instead.

T-004.Title: Prove the tap, the drag and the popup

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: test/tap_sound_area_test.dart pumps a real tap through the interceptor and asserts one press effect, then drags further than kTouchSlop and asserts nothing.
test/sound_navigator_observer_test.dart pumps a navigator carrying the observer, opens and closes a dialog, and asserts open then close; it also checks a page push and pop give navigate then back.
Both tests drive a real SoundService over a fake player, so no platform channel is touched.

T-005.Title: Record the automatic layer in the durable projection

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: M-SOUND's summary states that the press sound is automatic across every surface and that popups sound themselves.

V-M-SOUND gains the two test files, its command covers all four audio test files, and its scenarios state that a genuine tap clicks once while a drag stays silent, and that popups sound their own opening and closing.
